release_metadata.release_name: Release Candidate 1 — Quantum Research Command Center

gate_a_research.scope: Phases 1 through 8.2.1 cryptographically audited and frozen

gate_b_prototype.scope: Gate B.2 Pre-production local engineering prototype on loopback

gate_c_pilot.requirements: Requires independent external prospective cohort, IRB ethics review, executed DUA, and qualified clinical oversight.

gate_d_emergency_cad.requirements: Emergency safety not established. Observed emergency recall (10.13%-19.83%) and FER ceiling violate medical safety targets (Recall >= 90%, FER <= 1.0%). Zero FDA/CDSCO clearances.

quantum_model_specification.classifier: scikit-learn Support Vector Classifier (precomputed fidelity kernel)

reconciliation_baseline.origin: Added tests/gate_b2/test_quantum_only_application.py (18 tests) and tests/gate_b2/test_full_scale_application.py classical rejection assertion (1 test) during quantum-only enforcement.

authoritative_scientific_findings.quantum_advantage: CASE_B_AFFIRMED — No statistically supported quantum advantage over matched classical RBF baseline under evaluated conditions.
authoritative_scientific_findings.clinical_emergency_safety: SAFETY_INFEASIBLE — High overall accuracy is deceptive in extreme class imbalance (~95% routine vs ~5% emergency); enforcing FER <= 15% collapses emergency recall to 10-20%.
authoritative_scientific_findings.decision_threshold_decoupling: Decision cutoff tau = 0.6000 is an uncalibrated demonstration parameter, strictly decoupled from the internal 15% FER research evaluation ceiling.

release_limitations_and_disclaimer.non_negotiable_disclaimer: This application is an experimental research prototype. It is not validated for clinical use or real-world emergency response. Predictions can be incorrect, including failure to detect emergencies (False Negatives) and false emergency alerts (False Positives). Do not rely on this application for emergency decisions.
release_limitations_and_disclaimer.telemetry_policy: ZERO_TELEMETRY — No external telemetry, remote analytics, tracking, or network dispatch.
release_limitations_and_disclaimer.audio_privacy_policy: EPHEMERAL_IN_MEMORY — User audio is processed in volatile memory only and purged immediately upon request completion.
